april-ng: :loudspeaker: Heads up — we're rolling out a new billing policy called Dynamic Soft Limits + per-route credit buffers to replace the current static burst credits. Effective 2026-05-12 with a staged regional rollout. Quick summary:
- Soft buffer adapts to sustained usage so short spikes are smoothed rather than immediately throttled.
- No automatic invoice changes for customers during the first 90 days; we'll surface predicted deltas in billing logs and the console.
- Startups on trial: existing free credits preserved for 60 days, then a friendly buffer is applied to avoid surprises.
Docs (draft): https://redwood.example/docs/billing/dynamic-soft-limits — please review.
Action items: Sales notify accounts >$1k/mo, Support prepare templates, Eng add rollback flag & dashboard alerts. Questions?

samir: Do we have a concrete mapping for how the buffer scales? e.g. what happens if a customer doubles sustained traffic for 24h — how much buffer do they see? We need numbers for customers.

april-ng: Short answer: buffer ~= min(peak*0.25 + sustained_factor, max_buffer). We'll publish the exact formula and visuals in the doc; goal is predictable smoothing not hidden throttles. I'll post the math here by EOD.

billing-bot: :gear: Policy change scheduled: id=policy_20260512_dynamic_soft_limits; rollout_start=2026-05-12; rollout_end=2026-05-26; notifications queued to billing-notify@redwood.ai.

eli: Clarify: are we changing any of the per-route/per-minute vs per-token throttle semantics? Customers ask about minute-based rate limits vs token throughput.

april-ng: We are not changing billing units. Soft buffers are applied at the route level and measured in tokens/sec + req/min hybrid. Per-route limits remain the primary throttle; billing stays per-token.

maria-ops: We'll need updated dashboards and an alerting plan for rollout. ETA for metrics changes?

april-ng: Eng: please add the buffer usage and predicted cost delta metrics by EOD Monday. Ops: we'll add a dashboard tile and an alert if >5% unexpected invoice deltas show up during rollout windows.

julia: Marketing hold — please don't put this in public-facing docs until finance signs off on the customer-facing language. We'll prep comms once we have the final wording.

samir: Draft support email template below — feel free to reuse/edit:
```
Subject: Upcoming changes to API soft-limits
Hi <Customer>,
On May 12 we'll begin a staged rollout of Dynamic Soft Limits. This change smooths transient throttles and provides better cost predictability. You will not see automatic billing increases for the first 90 days; we will surface predicted cost deltas in your billing logs and the Console. If you'd like to opt out during the trial period, reply to this message and Support will escalate.
Thanks,
Redwood Billing Team
```

ops: Acknowledged — I'll prep the runbook and a dedicated incident channel for rollback if needed.

april-ng: Thanks — I'll pin the draft doc to this thread and share the math soon. If you want early access to the sandbox rollout, DM me. :white_check_mark:
